mission: Make approximately half of the approved museum feel like a materially authored premium space without rewriting navigation, focus, progress or cinematic inspection.

3D-room-portofolio: objects that feel active rather than decorative
hyacinth.im-site: landmark presence without copying circus/game aesthetics

perceptualTarget.statement: This half of the museum feels like another level of product.

wallPrimary.detail: panel depth and shadow joints rather than noisy texture

floorPrimary.rule: broad blurred reflection only; never mirror

lightingSystem.architectural: low ambient + directional/rail structure to model the room
lightingSystem.exhibit: each premium project has local controlled warm-neutral light
lightingSystem.interaction: focused exhibit may increase light/emissive response by approximately 8–15 percent
lightingSystem.rule: light reveals form and hierarchy; it must not behave like game feedback

premiumZone.coverage: approximately front 40–45 percent of the single gallery

treatments.aviation: framed hero with deep reveal, metal trim and plaque
treatments.ai-workspace: luminous media wall with smoked-glass layer and technical plinth
treatments.fashion: floating editorial panel with shadow gap and sculptural base

microInteractions: media wall emissive surface wakes on focus
floating panel backlight increases on focus
premium-zone architectural light creates a visible threshold

assetPolicy.textures: Use PBR textures only when licensed/source-clear and when geometry/material parameters cannot provide equivalent quality. 1K/2K default; 4K only for proven hero need.
assetPolicy.glb: Use GLB only when it solves scale, architecture or narrative. Phase 5.2 may use lightweight native R3F geometry for bench, rail, plinth and signage when no approved licensed GLB is already available.
assetPolicy.credits: No Higgsfield generation without an explicit visual role and the existing max-two-generations-per-function protocol.

human: baseline vs premium difference is immediate
three exhibits no longer look repeated
